assessment_objectives.objective: an After Action Review (AAR), or a similar lessons learned process, is conducted following incidents that require escalation to an Integrated Security Incident Response Team (ISIRT) or a similar integrated team of cybersecurity, IT and business function representatives.
events that would require the current incident response policy / procedures to be reviewed / updated are defined.
incident response documentation is updated to reflect changes identified from lessons learned during incident analysis and resolution.
events that initiate a review of the incident response training content are defined.
